fusions.name: Backwash Slam
fusions.desc: A wing slam that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Takeoff Gust
fusions.desc: Beats both wings in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to every enemy in it. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Settled Mass
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Flyer
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you cover, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
